project.name: Pytyliki
project.summary: C11 processor-systems workstation with read-only discovery, bounded measurements, source diagnostics, native interoperability, hardware-language frontends, switch-level modeling and Processor Fabric graph aggregation/planning.

capabilities.summary: Read-only CPU, memory and usable ISA discovery with operating-system vector-state checks.
Bounded processor, memory and matrix workloads for local, hardware-dependent comparison.
Static source diagnostics that inspect supported files without executing or rewriting them.
Bounded C11 syntax frontend accepts documented framed aliases and normalizes them to system(array); it does not execute source or access hardware.
PCM16 WAV and DSP processing are not present in the current source tree; this capability is incomplete and must not be advertised as shipped.
Typed views, overflow-checked slices, bounded arenas, rewind checkpoints and fixed-block pools.
C11 vector, distance, geometry and quadratic-form metrics with a stable native API.
Versioned C ABI v1 for explicitly configured native consumers; calls use caller-owned buffers.
Reference MCU profiles, bounded memory accounting, simulated MMIO masks and starter generation; not a physical mapper or firmware flasher.
Read-only capability and PATH discovery catalogue; detected tools are not executed or installed.
Repeatedly squares a bounded caller-supplied architecture matrix with deterministic saturating uint64 arithmetic.
Validates the complete three-project directed peer product, eight octagonal pyramid facets and local self-loops without a central runtime dependency.

Native C11 structural parser and catalogue cover twenty hardware-oriented construct forms. Compound Hyper-Switch and Epoch 4M samples are DAG-envelope references only; nested profile syntax, semantic analysis, lowering, code generation, simulation, RTL synthesis and hardware execution are not implemented.

C11 metadata registry maps the thirteen SystemArray suffix tokens to stable semantic IDs, type/array-plan signatures, effect classes and safety contracts; parsing and JSON metadata are implemented, while expression parsing, type-directed overload resolution, capability/effect checking, plan evaluation, IR lowering and hardware access are not implemented.
Bounded deterministic N/P MOS ideal-switch topology evaluation with VDD/VSS reachability and explicit high, low, floating, contended and indeterminate node states; not analog or SPICE simulation.

Processor Fabric ABI v2 is a bounded C11 inventory and process graph with topology evidence import, processor-group/NUMA/cache-sharing relations, typed resource references, deterministic base planning and NUMA/cache/SMT/bandwidth advisory placement. Four-word affinity masks preserve sparse logical CPU IDs up to 255. No task launches, OS scheduling changes or physical hardware effects are performed.

Native C11 read-only Windows/Linux topology collector records logical CPU IDs, processor groups where applicable, package/die/core, NUMA and shared cache evidence, ISA hardware-presence versus OS-usability, timestamps and generations. Platform coverage and bounds remain partial pending Windows/Linux CI and expanded topology fixtures.

Deterministic advisory process placement estimates CPU capacity/load, NUMA locality, shared-cache working-set pressure, SMT sibling contention and caller-supplied NUMA bandwidth pressure. A graph-aware PPF entry point checks READY process nodes and dependencies; CLI starts from a declared zero-pressure baseline. It does not set affinity, schedule or launch processes.

Bounded native C11 validators check typed address spaces, devices, memory regions, register banks/register permissions and overlap, DMA device/generation references, and explicit CPU/device ownership transitions. Validation mutates only caller-owned descriptors and performs no physical MMIO, mapping, cache maintenance or DMA submission.

interfaces.format: OCTA-8 octagonal-pyramid topology and peer contract
Native C11 caller-owned MOS switch topology and state-resolution API
Versioned JSON read-only OS topology and ISA evidence
Versioned JSON advisory placement and contention cost report
Typed caller-owned hardware resource and DMA ownership descriptors

integrations.summary: Reaper can call the metric ABI only when native FFI is explicitly enabled and a trusted library path is supplied.
OPlague can request a native metric cross-check using an explicitly supplied trusted library path.
Participates in the direct OCTA-8 peer mesh through explicit Reaper/Pytyliki orchestration and ABI calls.
Participates in the direct OCTA-8 peer mesh through explicit OPlague/Pytyliki native metric requests and responses.
A direct VentuSample-to-Pytyliki native metric/DSP adapter remains a future opt-in path; current pack descriptor comparison is orchestrated by Reaper and does not claim native audio rendering.

safety_boundaries: Processor and hardware inspection is read-only; no firmware, BIOS/UEFI, microcode, clock, voltage, driver or device-register writes are performed.
Source review does not execute or rewrite scanned files; benchmarks are bounded and hardware-dependent.
The Embedded C MMIO surface is simulated/reference-only and does not access physical device registers.
Native FFI consumers must explicitly select a trusted ABI-compatible library; ABI presence does not imply that every module is interoperable.
The system-array frontend validates one directive only; framing markers are metadata and never grant permissions or trigger hardware operations.

The hardware construct frontend performs structural syntax checks only; it does not compile or execute declarations, access processor registers, map memory, control clocks/voltage, submit DMA, patch code or synthesize hardware.
SystemArray sigil registry is metadata-only; no sigil executes, reads/writes memory, accesses a device, changes registers or grants capabilities.
The MOS switch-level model is a deterministic ideal-switch simulation only; it does not model analog current/voltage dynamics or access physical hardware.
Processor Fabric plans are advisory only: they do not spawn processes, modify host scheduling or affinity, write registers, map MMIO/DMA, change firmware, clocks or device state.
The processor topology collector is read-only and bounded; missing OS topology remains unknown/partial and out-of-bound CPU counts are rejected instead of truncated.

Processor Placement v2 is a deterministic advisory estimate only; CLI pressure inputs are zero-baseline unless explicitly supplied by an embedding caller, and no affinity or scheduler state is changed.

The typed hardware resource validator checks caller-owned descriptions and DMA ownership transitions only; it does not map MMIO, perform register access, install IOMMU mappings, submit DMA, or perform device/firmware operations.
extension_points: Versioned public C ABI and caller-owned buffer interfaces.
CMake library boundaries for adding independently tested C11 modules.
Evidence-backed architecture, MCU and toolchain profile catalogues.
Explicit adapter layer for trusted external native consumers.
Bounded saturating matrix self-product for repeated vertical architecture analysis.
Versioned system-array syntax AST for future typed array declarations and Reaper hardware-dialect integration.
Twenty versioned hardware construct families with structural AST nodes, ready for future grammar, type/effect checking, Hardware IR and Reaper adapter work.
Reference-only compound Hyper-Switch audio/system and Epoch 4M vacuum-lattice profile specimens; future token grammar, type/effect checks and target contracts remain unimplemented.
Versioned metadata registry for reserved SystemArray sigils; future semantic resolution must preserve source spans and lower to Reaper canonical typed IR.
Versioned MOS switch-level topology model with bounded reachability, ready for separately validated logic, sequential, timing and electrical-model layers.
Versioned Processor Fabric graph for CPU hierarchy, register/ISA/address-space resources, process pools, typed dependencies and deterministic advisory worker plans.
